location: Blackrock Mountain, between the Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes
entrance: Through the portal of Blackrock Spire, high in Blackrock Mountain. Inside, the Seal of Ascension opens the door to the left of the entrance.

4768.objective: Bring back the Darkstone Tablet. It lies in Upper Blackrock Spire.
4768.note: The Undercity has an optional breadcrumb that sends you to Vivian Lagrave.

4974.objective: Kill Warchief Rend Blackhand and bring his head to Thrall.
4974.note: First do Warlord's Command in Lower Blackrock Spire and Eitrigg's Wisdom.

6602.objective: Kill General Drakkisath and bring his blood to Rexxar.
6602.note: The end of the Horde attunement for Onyxia's Lair, a chain of thirteen quests that starts with Warlord's Command. Rexxar walks through Desolace.

4764.objective: Bring back Doomrigger's Clasp. It lies in Upper Blackrock Spire.
4764.note: Stormwind Keep has an optional breadcrumb that sends you to Mayara Brightwing.

5102.objective: Kill General Drakkisath and report to Marshal Maxwell.
5102.note: First do General Drakkisath's Command, which starts from an item of Overlord Wyrmthalak in Lower Blackrock Spire.

6502.objective: Kill General Drakkisath and bring his blood to Haleh.
6502.note: The end of the Alliance attunement for Onyxia's Lair, ten quests that start with Dragonkin Menace. Step on the blue rune at the end of Mazthoril to call Haleh.

7761.objective: Kill General Drakkisath and touch his brand behind him to gain the Mark of Drakkisath.
7761.note: Starts from Blackhand's Command, dropped by the Scarshield Quartermaster in the side hall of Blackrock Mountain. In Classic it opened Blackwing Lair.

5160.objective: Bring Awbee's scale to Haleh in Winterspring.
5160.note: Awbee sits on a small ledge in the room after Rend Blackhand.

5047.objective: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
5047.note: Pip Quickwit only appears when a player with Skinning 300 skins The Beast.

4735.objective: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil.
4735.note: The eggs lie in the Rookery; taking one can wake the whelps. Six quests of Tinkee come first.

6821.objective: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis.
6821.note: First do two quests for Duke Hydraxis in Azshara. The chain continues in Molten Core.

5127.objective: Kill Goraluk Anvilcrack, use the Blood Stained Pike on his body and bring Lorax the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
5127.note: Blacksmiths only. In Classic the reward was the Demon Forged Breastplate.
